content.speaker: character
content.text: HEY THERE!

content.speaker: someguy
content.text: WHAT DO YOU WANT?

content.speaker: character
content.text: JUST BEING NEIGHBOURLY.

content.speaker: character
content.text: HE DOESN'T SEEM THE NEIGHBOURLY TYPE.

content.speaker: character
content.text: I'M SELLING THESE FINE LEATHER JACKETS!

content.speaker: someguy
content.text: JACKETS?!

content.speaker: someguy
content.text: THAT'S RIDICULOUS!
THE FARMER SQUINTS INTO THE DISTANCE, UNCONVINCED.

content.speaker: character
content.text: HE'S RIGHT. IT IS RIDICULOUS.

content.speaker: character
content.text: I'M LOOKING FOR WORK. YOU GOT ANYTHING?

content.speaker: someguy
content.text: DEPENDS WHAT YOU CAN DO, BUCKAROO.

content.speaker: someguy
content.text: ARE YOU HANDY?

content.speaker: character
content.text: I CAN BE.
HE CHEWS ON SOMETHING THAT ISN'T THERE.

content.speaker: someguy
content.text: HMMM... THERE IS A TREE I NEED FELLED.

content.speaker: someguy
content.text: BIG OAK. BEEN BLOCKING MY VIEW FOR TWENTY YEARS.
HE GESTURES VAGUELY TOWARD THE TREELINE.
A TREE. THAT'LL DO. FOR NOW.
A CROW LANDS ON THE FENCE POST AND REGARDS YOU BOTH.

content.speaker: character
content.text: IS THAT YOUR HOUSE UP THERE?

content.speaker: someguy
content.text: IT SURE IS. YOU [b]BETCHA[/b]!
HE PUFFS OUT HIS CHEST A LITTLE.

content.speaker: character
content.text: THE HOUSE IS VERY NICE-LOOKING...

content.speaker: character
content.text: AND I BET IT'S FULL OF ANTIQUES...

content.speaker: someguy
content.text: THANKS, YES. SHE'S A BEAUT.
BEEN IN THE FAMILY SIXTY YEARS.
COULD FENCE THE ANTIQUES. RETIRE EARLY.
THE AFTERNOON LIGHT CATCHES THE WEATHERVANE ON THE ROOF.

content.speaker: character
content.text: NEED ANY REPAIR WORK DONE UP THERE?

content.speaker: someguy
content.text: MAYBE SO, MAYBE SO...

content.speaker: someguy
content.text: ROOF'S BEEN LEAKING SINCE THE STORM.
HE'S HIDING SOMETHING. OR JUST EMBARRASSED.
HE DOESN'T MEET YOUR EYES.

content.speaker: character
content.text: LET'S TALK ABOUT SOMETHING ELSE.

content.speaker: someguy
content.text: HAPPY TO.

content.speaker: character
content.text: HEY, WHAT'S THIS CANDLE DOING OUT HERE?

content.speaker: someguy
content.text: OH, THAT.
HE SHIFTS HIS WEIGHT SLIGHTLY.

content.speaker: someguy
content.text: KEEPS THE BIRDS OFF THE FENCE.

content.speaker: character
content.text: THAT'S NOT HOW ANY OF THIS WORKS.

content.speaker: character
content.text: THANKS FOR YOUR TIME.

content.speaker: someguy
content.text: VERY WELL. SEE YA 'ROUND, [b]SKIP[/b]!
HE TURNS BACK TO HIS FENCE WITHOUT ANOTHER WORD.
DON'T BE A STRANGER.
